# Rate My Crush Gift Guides

> Gift guides for adults shopping for girls ages 7–14, and the official fact page for Rate My Crush, a guided crush journal for girls 7–14 by Felicia Nevin (sold on Amazon in Playful, Moody and Floral editions).

## The journal
- [Rate My Crush facts and FAQ](https://gifts.ratemycrush.com/rate-my-crush/): ages 7–14, 100 pages, 6x9 paperback, 10-category star scorecard (50 stars), Crush Level heart meter, prompts; three editions with the same prompts styled to match each cover.
- Amazon: Playful https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FR24YJ8W · Moody https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FQPPSK1V · Floral https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FQPK7S8Q

## Gift guides
- [Gift Ideas for a 10-Year-Old Girl (That She'll Actually Use)](https://gifts.ratemycrush.com/gifts-for-10-year-old-girls/): Thoughtful, fun gift ideas for a 10-year-old girl: screen-free, creative and age-appropriate picks, plus a crush journal she'll laugh about when she's grown.
- [Stocking Stuffers for Tween Girls (Ages 8–14) That Aren't Just Candy](https://gifts.ratemycrush.com/stocking-stuffers-for-tween-girls/): Small, fun stocking stuffer ideas for tween girls ages 8 to 14, from gel pens to a crush journal she'll keep for years.
- [Fun Aunt Gift Guide: Gifts for Your Niece (Ages 7–14)](https://gifts.ratemycrush.com/gifts-for-niece/): Gift ideas for your niece ages 7 to 14 from the fun aunt: things her parents wouldn't think of, including a crush journal she'll love.
- [Valentine's Day Gifts for Girls That Aren't Candy (Ages 7–14)](https://gifts.ratemycrush.com/valentines-gifts-for-girls/): Non-candy Valentine's Day gift ideas for daughters, nieces and granddaughters ages 7 to 14, including a crush journal made for the season.
- [Screen-Free Gifts for Tween Girls She'll Actually Want](https://gifts.ratemycrush.com/screen-free-gifts-for-tween-girls/): Screen-free gift ideas for tween girls ages 8 to 14 that compete with a phone: journals, crafts, games and a crush journal she'll want to fill out.
- [Gifts for Your Granddaughter (Ages 7–14) From a Cool Grandma](https://gifts.ratemycrush.com/gifts-for-granddaughter/): Gift ideas for a granddaughter ages 7 to 14: fun, thoughtful picks that make Grandma the cool one, including a crush journal.
- [Sleepover Ideas for Tween Girls: Activities, Snacks and Games](https://gifts.ratemycrush.com/sleepover-ideas-for-tween-girls/): Easy sleepover ideas for tween girls ages 8 to 14: activities, games and snack ideas, plus a crush journal that makes a fun group activity.
